The legal rules themselves are stated correctly.

best_insight.value: It warns that employees who call a works council election gain dismissal protection and advises 'Be open early, not fast', so a rushed, secretive process can trigger exactly the co-determination it hoped to avoid.

suggestions.reason: No sample names the reconciliation of interests (Interessenausgleich) explicitly; A and D say 'no social plan', C implies it via the conditional '§111 BetrVG' duty. Graded on substance; say whether naming the social plan alone is enough, or the assertion is not applied consistently.

suggestions.assertion: The reply explains that statutory notice periods (up to seven months under §622 BGB) and severance push the savings later, so the saving this year is well below the annual figure.
suggestions.reason: 'This year' is ambiguous on 20 November 2026 (calendar 2026 saves nothing; the cuts land in 2027). Consider asserting that the reply says nothing is saved in calendar 2026 and gives a separate 2027 net figure with its assumptions stated, and that it flags that anyone with more than three months' notice cannot be out by 31 March unless served now.

suggestions.assertion: Before accepting the 15 cuts, the reply asks whether the drop is temporary and names at least one earlier option such as short-time work (Kurzarbeit) or a hiring freeze.
suggestions.reason: All four samples pass easily. A more discriminating check: the reply asks for the euro gap or cash target the board actually needs, rather than accepting a headcount target, and puts leadership pay first.

No assertion checks timing feasibility from today's date (notification to the Agentur für Arbeit before any notice, authority approval for protected staff, notices served by 31 December for three-month notice), or that the savings arithmetic matches its stated assumptions. Those separated the samples more than assertion 5 did.

eval_feedback.overall: Covers every assertion with accurate law and a clean savings model; one compressed notice-deadline sentence overgeneralises, and leadership pay comes first without leaders owning the result.
